entities.summary: Matthew Boris "Matt" Kvesic is an English professional rugby union player for Worcester Warriors. Born in Iserlohn, Germany, to English parents of Croatian and Polish roots, he represented England at international level and played for several youth representative sides before making his debut for the senior team in 2013. Predominantly an openside flanker, he has also played on the blindside flanker and at number eight.
